fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 46 days present material risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: Congressional activity is minimal and non-directional; market fear (38/100) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and weak insider conviction limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (84.7) indicates extreme market stress, NFP event imminent; earnings in 46 days adds moderate binary risk but secondary to acute macro deterioration.
